problem_statement: WRITE_BIT() does not work on 64-bit bitfields. Setting or clearing a bit at a position of 32 or higher in a 64-bit unsigned integer does not actually set or clear that bit, so the bit field is left in an incorrect state. After the fix, WRITE_BIT(var, bit, true) must set any of the 64 bits of a uint64_t and WRITE_BIT(var, bit, false) must clear any of them, for every bit position from 0 to 63.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p qemu_x86 -T tests/lib/sys_util -s tests/lib/sys_util/libraries.sys_util -s libraries.sys_util -O twister-out --no-clean -W
